caption:
Koko has been walking a lot more lately. Now the inside of her ankle is sore, and one arch looks a little flatter.

The tibialis posterior tendon runs past the inner ankle and helps support the arch. A sudden jump in walking can irritate it. Adjusting load, supportive shoes and strength work are usually the first steps.

Hybi's 1-minute routine: holding a wall, rise onto your toes and lower slowly over 3 seconds, 10 reps × 2 sets. Stop if pain gets worse.

One arch flattening, trouble rising onto one foot, or swelling is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
